items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1983-05-28
items.q: Interviewer mentions Dorothy Riga had Lafitte's Guesthouse later; Interviewee responds about the timing of the opening but does not claim a personal relationship with Dorothy Riga.

ctx.x: huh now that you mentioned it was Lafitte's Guesthouse and uh I've never heard anybody say anything mention anything about Noon or anything much about McNeil Bro for that matter but they played some they played some very agreeable music this would have been in uh oh I guess in the quite early 50s yeah

yeah well I think it was it was early 1950 that I moved over from Algiers to 1111 Bourbon I'd always looking for somebody to live in the other half of the house and of course we would have discovered that and Dorothy Riga had Lafitte's Guesthouse later she had them
seems to me though seems to me that they didn't open this until a little bit after until a bit after you moved into 1111
